name: Bézier Lab
desc: A draggable Bézier curve with de Casteljau's construction, the control hull, curvature and the osculating circle — all checked against each other.
controls: Parameter, degree and curvature-scale sliders, three shape presets, hull and construction toggles, draggable control points, click to pick a parameter; keys 1–3 load presets, H and D toggle overlays
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
